item.text:
S. 2817 “has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: the memo says there are three cosponsors but names only two]

“the stakes for our company has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our company have never been higher”

“federal goverment” >>> “federal government”

“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”

“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”

“central principal” >>> “central principle”

“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”

“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: earlier, Whitfield is identified as R-OH]

“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: the registry is described earlier as being in Section 4]

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty” >>> [CHECK: earlier, Section 5 sets the daily civil penalty at up to $1 million]

“Senator Grant, who's support” >>> “Senator Grant, whose support”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“Senator Gallager” >>> “Senator Gallagher”

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee’s 28 members”

“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: these figures total 29, not 28]

“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow” >>> [CHECK: this lists five undecided senators, but the preceding count says six]

“before the markup on Thursday, October 14” >>> [CHECK: the memo gives the markup date as Thursday, October 15; October 14, 2026, is a Wednesday]

“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”

“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“the week November 16” >>> “the week of November 16”

“hearing … occured” >>> “hearing … occurred”

“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”

“our six regional policy leads” >>> [CHECK: later the memo says each of five regional policy leads will be available]

“the the offices” >>> “the offices”

“please ask them to call there senators” >>> “please ask them to call their senators”

“you should recieve” >>> “you should receive”
